description: A cozy, vintage-style bedroom nightstand vignette suffused in warm, honeyed light. The nightstand is a small dark-stained wooden side table with carved detailing, on which rest two stacked books, a white ceramic teacup, and a small dried floral arrangement in a short vase. Behind it, a wrought iron bed headboard with ornate scrollwork in dark antiqued bronze provides a strong vertical element. The wallpaper behind is a soft cream ground with a small repeated botanical or toile pattern in muted blush-rose tones. A multi-pane window to the upper left admits soft morning light, bathing the scene in warm golden diffusion. The bed linens feature a vintage floral quilt in cream and soft rose. The entire color palette is warm and muted — honey, cream, dusty rose — with the wood tones anchoring the scene in warm amber. The atmosphere is lived-in, cottage-y, and quietly nostalgic. Camera is at a low-to-seated eye level, framing a tight vignette of the nightstand and bed corner using a normal lens. The composition is slightly off-center with the nightstand at center-left and the bed headboard filling the right background. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
